# Tru8 Evidence Research API

> Structured evidence research for AI agents. Submit a claim or URL, get back
> source-traced evidence organized by tier and type, with element decomposition
> and relationship mapping.

## API Base

https://api.tru8.app

## Authentication

Header: X-API-Key: <your_key>
Keys: POST /api/v1/api-keys (requires JWT)
Docs: https://tru8.app/developers

## Agent Tier Endpoints (recommended for agents)

Three tiers with automatic fallback. Set max_tier to control maximum spend.

POST /api/v1/agent/lookup — cached prior analysis (~$0.02, instant)
POST /api/v1/agent/quick  — web search + heuristic classification (~$0.07, ~15s)
POST /api/v1/agent/full   — 30+ sources, LLM classification, coverage recovery (~$0.15, ~90s)

Request body: {"claim": "...", "compact": false}
Response includes _meta block: {executedTier, chargedCents, limitations, cached}

Charges based on tier actually executed, not tier requested. Lookup returns
a structured miss (HTTP 200 with hit=false) when no cached result exists —
the agent can then decide whether to escalate to quick or full.

GET /api/v1/agent/credits/balance — check prepaid credit balance
POST /api/v1/agent/credits/purchase — buy credit packs via Stripe ($5/$20/$100)
GET /api/v1/agent/result/{check_id} — retrieve a completed result (free, identity only)
GET /api/v1/agent/stats — aggregated usage by tier and provider

### Payment Rails

Three payment options:
- API key + prepaid credits (recommended): X-API-Key header, balance in USD cents
- Skyfire KYAPay: skyfire-pay-id JWT header, automatic settlement
- x402 USDC: HTTP 402 challenge/response on /api/v1/agent/x402/* endpoints

x402 endpoints mirror the agent tier endpoints:
POST /api/v1/agent/x402/lookup — same as /agent/lookup, paid via USDC
POST /api/v1/agent/x402/quick  — same as /agent/quick, paid via USDC
POST /api/v1/agent/x402/full   — same as /agent/full, paid via USDC

### Human Dashboard Endpoints (not for agents)

POST /api/v1/checks/run — synchronous, blocks until complete (timeout >= 180s)
POST /api/v1/checks/stream — SSE progress stream
GET /api/v1/checks/{id} — retrieve completed result
GET /api/v1/checks/{id}?computed=true — result with pre-computed analytics

## Pipeline

Full pipeline (typically 60-120s): extract claims → retrieve evidence from multiple
independent sources → decompose each claim into verifiable elements → map evidence
to elements with relationship labels. Includes coverage recovery for low-coverage claims.

Quick pipeline (~15s): extract claims → web search → heuristic classification.
Skips LLM classification, fact-check lookup, API adapters, coverage recovery, and
query answering.

## Evidence Model

Sources classified on two axes:
- Tier: primary (original data/measurements) | reporting (news coverage) | commentary (opinion/analysis)
- Type: data | official | news | analysis | opinion | academic

Each claim is decomposed into verifiable elements. Evidence is mapped to elements
with relationship labels: supports | challenges | context.

Element states (derived mechanically, no editorial judgment):
- supported — preponderance of evidence supports this element
- disputed — conflicting evidence exists
- unresolved — insufficient evidence to determine

## Computed Analytics (?computed=true)

Adds a _computed block: summary (element state counts, coverage gaps),
evidenceByTier, evidenceByType, heatmap (tier×type matrix), corroboration
(evidence groups citing same facts), diagnosticValues (per-evidence
analytical scores), timeline (date range, gaps), perClaim (dispositions).

## MCP Server

Package: tru8-mcp — pip install tru8-mcp (or uvx tru8-mcp)
Run: tru8-mcp (or python -m tru8_mcp)
Env: TRU8_API_KEY (required), TRU8_API_URL (optional)

Tools:
- tru8_check(claim, max_tier="quick", compact=False) — evidence research with
  tier fallback (lookup → quick → full up to max_tier). Returns structured
  evidence landscape with _meta block (executedTier, chargedCents, limitations).
- tru8_get_result(check_id) — retrieve result with computed analytics
- tru8_get_result_raw(check_id) — retrieve result without computed analytics

## Rate Limits

- General: 60 req/min
- Check creation: 10 req/min

- Swagger: https://api.tru8.app/api/docs
- ReDoc: https://api.tru8.app/api/redoc
